name: MOON STRIKE
source:
Main character decided to undergo an operation and become metanoid because of revenge. Afterwards he fought on as a warrior of justice as "Silver Blast" for the Future Hope Foundation. After the fight with criminal organization Django there were no longer serious threats for the city, so he retired. But there is a new danger now. Does flame of justice still burn in his soul?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-november-2006-haruka-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角為了復仇，決定接受手術，變成改造人。此後，他化身「銀色爆破」，以未來希望基金會正義戰士的身分繼續戰鬥。與犯罪組織「Django」一戰後，城市不再面臨重大威脅，他也就此隱退。然而新的危險已經迫近。正義的火焰是否仍在他心中燃燒？

[譯自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-november-2006-haruka-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
